original_test_intent: Validate OAM_2 power consumption reporting across controller, host and UI surfaces without altering device power state.
original_method: Map equivalent OAM_2 power channels and boundaries, collect synchronized readings in an approved operating state, preserve validity/status flags, normalize units and compare ranges and deltas using an engineering oracle.
manual_activity: Power/GPU owner approves OAM_2 channel semantics and validity states and decides all anomalies.
required_inputs: OAM_2 identity and equivalent power-channel map
Secure access and matching Web evidence
safety_requirements: Read only and avoid power actions
Never convert missing/unavailable to numeric zero
Stop on invalid status, stale sample or unmatched domain
agent_execution_scope: Retain raw validity/status with numeric data
Normalize only approved channels and calculate comparisons
Escalate rather than infer a result

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Redfish member is relevant, but its unsafe single metric neither covers the required interfaces nor distinguishes invalid zero-like output.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely capture OAM_2 power and validity states from Redfish, IPMI, ROCm and Web in one approved operating window and compare only equivalent channels.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OAM_2, all three command sources, Web parity and original timing are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Represent each raw channel as value plus unit, validity/status, boundary, averaging window and time before any conversion or delta calculation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents unavailable telemetry from being accepted as a plausible zero-watt reading.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No external-meter calibration or power-state transition is added.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A truly idle module can report low power; only status plus approved range can distinguish it from a failed sensor.

project_override_considerations: Engineering defines which OAM_2 validity flags and zero values are acceptable in each intended power/driver state.
expected_evidence: Full redacted Redfish/IPMI/ROCm output with validity flags
Logs, exception decisions, cleanup and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests OAM_2 power parity; historical automation is simply partial and unsafe.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Metric mapping, access and confirmation can be provided as prerequisites.

review_improvement: Preserves validity semantics so missing or failed OAM_2 power telemetry cannot masquerade as a correct zero.
independent_technical_reasoning: Many telemetry APIs serialize unavailable data as zero, null, NaN or a separate status token. Dropping the status during numeric parsing can turn a failed channel into a plausible idle value. OAM_2 evidence must therefore keep raw validity and operating state attached to every sample before range or cross-interface comparisons are attempted.
